# SA Innovative World

> Pre-owned cars and flexible financing in North Hollywood, CA.

SA Innovative World is a used car dealership on Lankershim Blvd in North Hollywood, California, offering quality pre-owned vehicles and financing through multiple lenders.

## Key facts
- Address: 6829 Lankershim Blvd, Unit 226, North Hollywood, CA 91605
- Phone (sales): (626) 764-5340
- Email: sainnovativeworld@gmail.com
- Live inventory: https://siw.mycarsonline.com/inventory/
- Credit application: https://siw.mycarsonline.com/apply-online/
- Car Finder (request a vehicle): https://siw.mycarsonline.com/car-finder/
- Sells pre-owned vehicles. Financing through multiple third-party lenders, subject to approval. Good credit, bad credit, and first-time buyers may apply; co-buyers and trade-ins can be added on the application.
